derived_records.identity: keccak256(abi.encode(schemaMajor, schemaMinor, domain, subjectId, sourceSetHash, aggregationVersion, windowStart, windowEnd))
derived_records.rule: derived aggregates must reference a nonzero canonical source-set hash and nonzero aggregation version

invariants: indexing never grants execution or custody authority
record identity is stable and idempotent for one canonical log
block hash participates in record identity so reorg replacements cannot collide with orphaned records
transaction hash and log index participate in record identity
canonical subject identifiers are schema-versioned and kind-domain-separated
orphaned records remain distinguishable from canonical replacements
derived fields cannot overwrite canonical event fields
derived identity binds source-set hash, aggregation version and time window
invalid zero provenance or aggregation identifiers fail closed
all public schemas are versioned before V14 UI consumption
qualification_tests: same canonical log produces the same nonzero record ID
reorg replacement block hash produces a distinct record ID
transaction hash or log-index changes produce distinct record IDs
market, asset, route, adapter and order subject kinds are domain-separated
derived records change identity when aggregation version changes
derived records change identity when source set or window changes
zero chain, block hash or transaction hash provenance is rejected
zero aggregation version and empty aggregation windows are rejected
